cases.name: replacement regular compiler
cases.mutation: replace gcc at the recorded absolute path with another regular executable
cases.mustReject: actual executable SHA-256 differs from generation.toolchain.gcc.sha256

cases.name: banner compatible replacement version
cases.mutation: replace gcov with a regular executable that reports semver 14.3.0 while metadata and pin remain 14.2.0
cases.mustReject: fresh first-semver detection differs from metadata.version and UNIT_TEST_IDE_GCC_VERSION

cases.name: metadata tool outside allowed root
cases.mutation: set a syntactically valid absolute gcc metadata path outside allowedDirectory
cases.mustReject: realpath is not a child of the trusted allowedDirectory
